svg.title: How NullCase diagnoses a flaky test
svg.desc: A flaky test passes locally and fails in CI. NullCase re-runs it 20 times with every factor pinned and 20 times each with one factor changed. Only the test-order runs fail (13 of 20 against 0 of 20). Their 95% Wilson intervals don't overlap, so the diagnosis is order_dependent, with a repro command that failed 3 of 3 replays.
svg.text: Finds out why a flaky pytest test is flaky, by controlled experiment.
on your laptop, in file order
20 runs each · a fresh pytest process per run · fixed seeds
no overlap → order is the cause
A diagnosis you can act on
the test depends on state that other tests leave behind
Reported in the GitHub Actions job summary, as an annotation on the test, and as JSON.
